# Chemotaxis III manuscript

> Public manuscript and reproducibility materials for "Chemotaxis models with signal-dependent sensitivity and a logistic-type source, III: Bifurcation and spike-like solutions" (Le Chen, Ian Ruau, Wenxian Shen). The source here is the arXiv e-print of arXiv:2610.20976v2 (October 23, 2026), unchanged.

Claim boundaries:
- This repository does not assert journal submission or acceptance. Theorem and equation numbering is the same in v1 and v2.
- The Lean companion distinguishes 47 verified scopes, 23 conditional scopes, and 3 exclusions across 73 overlapping manuscript-facing scopes. These are not percentages of whole-paper correctness. The whole paper is not Lean-certified.
- Manuscript and figures remain copyright their authors; no additional manuscript license is granted.

## Manuscript

- [Chen-Ruau-Shen-JMB.tex](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/chemotaxis-paper-iii/main/Chen-Ruau-Shen-JMB.tex): LaTeX source; theorems are stated in the Introduction
- [references.bib](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/chemotaxis-paper-iii/main/references.bib): bibliography
- [arXiv-2610.20976v2.pdf](https://github.com/chenle02/chemotaxis-paper-iii/blob/main/arXiv-2610.20976v2.pdf): the PDF served by arXiv
- [manuscript-manifest.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/chemotaxis-paper-iii/main/manuscript-manifest.json): SHA-256 of every manuscript file and of the e-print
- [build.sh](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/chemotaxis-paper-iii/main/build.sh): pdfLaTeX build with an unresolved-reference check

## Lean companion

- [chemotaxis-paper-iii-lean llms.txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/chemotaxis-paper-iii-lean/main/llms.txt): the formalization's own map and claim boundary
- [Documentation site](https://chenle02.github.io/chemotaxis-paper-iii-lean/): what is proved, results by paper section, exact Lean statements

## Optional

- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/chemotaxis-paper-iii/main/README.md): human landing page with the abstract
- [CITATION.cff](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenle02/chemotaxis-paper-iii/main/CITATION.cff): citation metadata
